# onepassword_api_credentials (Resource)

Manage 1Password API credentials items.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Item title.
- `vault` (String) 1Password vault title.

### Optional

- `credential` (Block, Optional) Credential recipe for API access. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--credential))
- `expires` (String) Expiration date.
- `filename` (String) Credential filename.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname.
- `note` (String) Item note.
- `notes` (String) Item notes (deprecated in favor of note).
- `sections` (Attributes) Item sections map. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sections))
- `tags` (List of String) Item tags.
- `type` (String) Credential type.
- `username` (String) API username.
- `valid_from` (String) Valid from date.
- `version` (Number) Version trigger to refresh ephemeral values.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Item ID.
